title: Counterattack from the Dead
next_chapter_hook: In the instant when the blood resonance between the siblings reached its peak, the Heavenly Fate Key power dormant within Chen Nian suddenly awakened — the purity and terror of that force caused Chen Ji's pupils to contract sharply, making him realize that this rescue was far from simple.

text.content: The pressure of the Heavenly Eye crushed down like a physical force. Chen Ji felt as though ten thousand pounds weighed upon him, making even breathing a struggle. Yet his gaze remained locked on the fourth fragment suspended in the Void — its golden radiance emanating an otherworldly presence, resonating with some unseen power. "So you've finally decided to show yourself?" His lips curved into a cold smile. "I've been waiting for you for a long time."

The Holy Sect Elder's face changed dramatically. The pressure exceeding mortal limits caused even this Tribulation Crossing cultivator to feel deep unease. He never expected that a mere Jindan stage waste would possess something so terrifying. "Wh-What is this?!" His voice lost its composure for the first time. "Impossible! How could a Heavenly artifact appear in your hands!"

Chen Ji ignored his shock, his fingers already pressing against the fourth fragment. The power of the Tianji Record surged into his consciousness like a tide — threads of fate, trajectories of the future, chains of causality. For the first time, he saw the course of destiny with such clarity. "Mister Mo," he whispered in his heart, "This game, I will be the one playing it."

dialogue.content: The remnant soul's voice echoed in his Mental Sea, carrying a hint of satisfaction: "You've finally taken this step. Remember, the power of the fourth page lies in 'defying destiny' — you can actively pluck the strings of fate. But each time you do, you must pay a corresponding price. Act carefully."

choice.prompt: Facing the dual pressure of the Holy Sect Elder and the Heavenly Eye, Chen Ji must make a choice — risk activating the full power of the fourth page, or use fate foresight to find a flaw?

choices.description: Actively manipulate the trajectory of fate, forcibly rewrite the outcome of this confrontation, but will consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate and may attract further attention from the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_reward: Fate power rebounds against the enemy
choices.risk_hint: May trigger the Heavenly Eye's full intervention ahead of schedule

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his fingers pressing hard on the fourth page. In an instant, golden light exploded from his palm, transforming into countless tiny threads of fate spreading in all directions. When those threads touched the Holy Sect Elder, they directly coiled around his threads of causality! "You—" The Elder widened his eyes, trying to break free, only to find those threads tightening further.

dialogue.content: "Did you think I was merely enduring all this time?" Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold as the Nine Nether Abyss. "Because I was waiting for an opportunity — an opportunity to personally drag you into the abyss of fate!" His eyes reflected countless interwoven threads of destiny, the countless possibilities of the future, and he was forcibly making one of them a reality.

choices.description: Use the foresight ability of the Tianji Record to seize the Holy Sect Elder's momentary weakness, accomplishing the rescue at the smallest cost.
choices.risk_hint: Can only see a fleeting moment of opportunity that vanishes in an instant

text.content: A golden light flickered in Chen Ji's pupils as images of fate flashed before him like a carousel. Within those fragments of the future, he caught a fleeting instant — three breaths later, the Holy Sect Elder's attention would be briefly distracted by the Heavenly Eye's pressure. That was his only flaw. "Three breaths," he counted silently, "Only three breaths."

dialogue.content: He deeply carved this vision into his mind, a knowing smile appearing at the corner of his lips. "So that's how it is," he murmured to himself. "The Heavenly Eye wants to use me, but also fears the Tianji Record in my hands. Between us, it's merely a relationship of mutual exploitation — very well, let's see who can exploit the other better."

choices.description: Avoid direct confrontation with the enemy for now, instead attempt blood resonance with his sister to shatter the formation from within.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's inner power is unknown and may spiral out of control

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush to attack. Instead, he closed his eyes and extended his divine sense toward the imprisoned Chen Nian at the formation's center. That familiar bloodline aura pulsed weakly through the formation's barrier, like a lighthouse swaying in the wind. "Nian Nian," he called softly in his heart, "Brother is here to save you." In the next moment, a warm force surged from his chest — the dormant bond within the Chen bloodline.

dialogue.content: Inside the formation, Chen Nian's tightly closed eyes suddenly trembled. She sensed that call from the depths of her bloodline, the warmth she had thought lost long ago. "Brother...Brother?" Her lips quivered slightly, voice as soft as a mosquito's whine yet carrying irrepressible excitement. Trapped for years, she had never given up hope, and now, that light had finally appeared.

text.content: Just then, the Heavenly Eye's pressure underwent a subtle change. It seemed to sense Chen Ji's intention, and that gaze piercing through the Void carried added scrutiny and amusement. Chen Ji's heart tensed — he knew that gaze only too well. It was like a hunter looking at prey in a trap, unsure whether to call it foolish or naive.

dialogue.content: A grand voice exploded directly in his mind: "Interesting... an ant dares to attempt shaking the great tree. A fragment of the Tianji Record? Hmph, nothing more than a discarded piece on my chessboard. You think the fourth page in your hands is your trump card, but you don't realize it is precisely the key I have been waiting for." The voice carried no emotion whatsoever, yet it made every hair on Chen Ji's body stand on end.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Discarded piece? Key? These two words spun rapidly in his mind, piecing together a truth that sent chills down his spine. The appearance of the fourth page, his acquisition of it, its activation now — could all of this have been part of someone's scheme? "Did you deliberately let me obtain it?" he demanded through gritted teeth. The only response was a flash of mockery in that Eye.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye reveals its true fangs, Chen Ji is caught between a rock and a hard place — passively fall into its scheme, or proactively break the chess game?

choices.description: Since the Heavenly Eye wants to use the fourth page, let it have its way — but Chen Ji will reverse fate the instant it reaches for the harvest, dragging it into the abyss along with him.
choices.visible_reward: May severely wound the Heavenly Eye's consciousness
choices.risk_hint: If it fails, he will be reduced to a puppet forever

text.content: A resolute light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. Since the other party wanted to treat him as a chess piece, he would be a piece daring to overturn the entire board! "You want the fourth page?" He suddenly burst into laughter. "Then have it!" Before the words even finished, he actively pushed the fourth fragment toward the Heavenly Eye, while his Heavenly Fate burned furiously within him, transforming into scalding threads of fate that wrapped around the golden page.

dialogue.content: "You want the key?" His voice turned ice-cold. "Then let me show you what door this key truly opens!" The fourth fragment, enhanced by burning Heavenly Fate, erupted with unprecedented light. That radiance contained not merely raw power, but countless tampered因果, countless severed fates — the resentments of the prophets devoured across generations!

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's pupils contracted violently. The intensity and purity of that resentment far exceeded its expectations. It tried to retract that power, only to find it was already too late — those resentments clung to its consciousness like gnawing bones, precisely the "debt" it accumulated from devouring prophets across the ages. "You—!" The grand voice trembled for the first time.

choices.text: Sever the Limb to Save the Body · Sacrifice the Fourth Page
choices.description: Abandon the fourth fragment, using it as bait in exchange for an opportunity to escape. Protecting himself and his sister is the top priority.
choices.risk_hint: Loses an important trump card, and may be tracked by the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated only for an instant before making his decision. Though the fourth page was powerful, everything was worth sacrificing to protect himself and Nian Nian. He hurled the fourth fragment toward the Heavenly Eye with explosive force, while his body shot backward, seizing the teetering Chen Nian within the formation. "Go!" he hissed, pushing his true essence to the limit.

dialogue.content: "Think you can escape?!" The Holy Sect Elder reacted first, slapping toward Chen Ji's back. However, just then, the Heavenly Eye's attention was completely drawn to the incoming fourth page — its consciousness greedily lunged for it. This momentary "distraction" gave Chen Ji his final chance.

text.content: "We shall meet again." Chen Ji's voice drifted from the distance, carrying a strange smile. The Heavenly Eye suddenly sensed something wrong — the power within that fourth page was far more complex than it had imagined. When it tried to devour it, an even more massive force of destiny erupted violently, directly tearing apart part of its consciousness! "No—!"

choices.description: Ignore the Heavenly Eye's schemes entirely, pour all power into blood resonance, forcibly awaken the Heavenly Fate Key power within Chen Nian, and break all shackles with absolute force.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of Heavenly Fate reaching zero
choices.visible_reward: Heavenly Fate Key power awakens, may change the situation
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk of power loss of control, may harm Chen Nian

text.content: "To hell with your schemes!" Chen Ji roared, pressing the Tianji Record fourth page directly against his heart. Agonizing pain surged through him as his Heavenly Fate plummeted, but in its place came an unprecedented power — the blessing of destiny itself, a brief deviation from the law of causality. His eyes turned pure gold, and his aura swelled to an incredible magnitude.

"Nian Nian!" His voice penetrated the formation. "Give me your hand!" Chen Nian struggled to extend her arm, their fingertips touching through a gap in the formation. In that instant, the dormant power within the Chen bloodline fully awakened — a blazing radiance erupted from Chen Nian's body, the sign of the Heavenly Fate Key being forcibly activated! When the two forces met, the entire space trembled.

dialogue.content: "Brother..." Chen Nian's voice was no longer weak, but carried an ethereal quality. Her eyes also turned golden, echoing with Chen Ji's. "I can feel it... such overwhelming power..." Tears streamed down her face. "So this is what has been dormant in our bloodline all along..."

text.content: The Holy Sect Elder's expression changed completely. The purity and terror of that power had far exceeded his comprehension. "Th-This is... the complete awakening of the Heavenly Fate Key?!" His voice trembled. "Impossible! It hasn't matured yet! How could—" Before he could finish, the golden light had completely torn apart the formation he had arranged!

The moment the formation shattered, Chen Ji pulled Chen Nian into his embrace. The siblings stood facing each other, eyes meeting. The years of separation, the suffering endured alone — all of it transformed into silent tears in this moment. "I'm sorry," Chen Ji's voice choked, "Brother is late." Chen Nian shook her head, forcing a smile with all her strength: "Not late... as long as Brother is here... it's never late..."

dialogue.content: Chen Nian leaned against Chen Ji's chest, still physically weak, but the light in her eyes brighter than ever. "Brother, all these years... I've been trapped in darkness... but I never gave up hope, because I always believed you would come to save me." Her fingers tightly gripped Chen Ji's robe, as if afraid he would disappear again. "Now... I've finally waited for this moment..."

text.content: The Holy Sect Elder snapped back to his senses from shock, his face ashen. "Think you can leave?!" He gritted his teeth, channeling all his true essence, and slapped toward Chen Ji's back. However, to his surprise, Chen Ji didn't even turn around. He simply said calmly: "Nian Nian, lend me some power." Chen Nian understood, pressing her palm against his back — in an instant, a golden shield formed behind them, easily deflecting that palm strike powerful enough to shatter mountains!

"Th-This is impossible!" The Holy Sect Elder gaped. His full-power strike couldn't even scratch the siblings' shield! Chen Ji slowly turned around, looking at this once-untouchable Tribulation Crossing cultivator, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his lips: "What was it you said just now? Waste? Chess piece?" His voice wasn't loud, yet every word cut to the heart. "Now, who is the waste? Who is the chess piece?"

choice.prompt: The moment to completely crush the Holy Sect Elder has arrived. Chen Ji must make the final decision — how to deal with this once-unstoppable enemy?

choices.description: Give him no chance to make a comeback, directly erase him with fate power, and harvest his causal power to nourish himself.
choices.visible_reward: Causal harvest, slight increase in strength
choices.risk_hint: May absorb too much karma, leaving hidden troubles

text.content: Chen Ji raised his hand, a golden light condensing in his palm. That was the power of destiny, the unique authority of a Tianji Record holder. "Do you know what it feels like to be abandoned by fate?" His voice was ice-cold as the abyss. "Let me show you." The light shot forth, accurately striking the Holy Sect Elder's brow center — the convergence point of all causal threads.

dialogue.content: "No—!" The Holy Sect Elder let out a tragic scream. His threads of causality were being stripped away one by one — an experience more terrifying than death. "You can't kill me! I am an Elder of the Holy Sect! If you kill me, the Holy Sect won't let you go!" Chen Ji coldly watched his struggles: "The Holy Sect?" His tone overflowed with contempt. "You think I'm afraid?"

text.content: As the final thread of causality was stripped away, the Holy Sect Elder's body began to turn transparent, eventually dissolving into scattered starlight in the Void. He didn't even have time to scream before being completely erased from existence. Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his expression terrifyingly calm. Those causal forces transformed into a warm current flowing into his body, slightly strengthening his aura. "Let's go." He murmured, embracing Chen Nian and streaking toward the distance.

choices.text: Spare His Life · Plant a Chess Piece
choices.description: Killing him would be too merciful. Instead, let him live and return with fear and despair to the Holy Sect, becoming a hidden chess piece that could be detonated at any moment.
choices.visible_reward: Plant hidden troubles within the Holy Sect

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand, the golden light dissipating into the Void. The Holy Sect Elder collapsed to the ground, trembling violently, his eyes filled with the relief of surviving a disaster and deep-rooted terror. He couldn't understand why the other party would spare him. "Get out of here," Chen Ji's voice was icy cold. "Tell every single person in the Holy Sect what you witnessed today. Let them know the price of angering me."

dialogue.content: "Yo-You'll regret this!" The Elder threatened weakly. Chen Ji chuckled lightly, extending a finger to tap his brow center. In the next instant, an almost invisible golden thread sank into the depths of his Mental Sea. "I left you a little gift in your Mental Sea," Chen Ji said calmly. "If you ever have any thoughts harmful to me, or if you hide what happened today, it will help you find 'release.' Go ahead, I look forward to your good news."

text.content: Watching the Holy Sect Elder's humiliated fleeing figure, Chen Nian looked at her brother with worry. "Brother, is this really okay? He is a Tribulation Crossing cultivator after all..." Chen Ji ruffled her hair, saying gently: "Nian Nian, remember — the dead can only make people fear for a moment, but the living despair makes people fear for a lifetime. Him returning alive is worth more than killing him ten thousand times."

choices.description: Now is not the time to make more enemies. Killing him would bring the Holy Sect's crazy retaliation. Take Nian Nian and leave first, settle accounts later.
choices.visible_reward: Safe escape, avoid Holy Sect's full-scale pursuit
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect Elder may return for revenge

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the surging killing intent in his heart. This was not the time for venting emotions. Nian Nian had just escaped captivity and her body was extremely weak — no time for further trouble. "Today I shall spare your life." He coldly stared at the Holy Sect Elder. "But remember, the next time we meet, you won't be so fortunate." Before the words finished, he had already transformed into a streak of light with Chen Nian in his arms, speeding toward the horizon.

The Holy Sect Elder sat sprawled on the ground, staring blankly at the light vanishing on the horizon for a long time. Everything that happened today completely overturned his understanding — the disciple called waste, the servant, actually possessed such terrifying power; and the Heavenly Fate Key that should have been completely suppressed, never to awaken, had erupted with destructive force at the critical moment. "It's over... it's all over..." He murmured, his face ashen as death.

Meanwhile, deep within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, Mister Mo's voice sounded faintly: "Well done. Being able to stay calm in such a situation shows you have begun to understand what true 'strategy' is. However..." His tone suddenly turned grave. "The power awakened in your sister's body is far more complex than I imagined. That is not merely the Heavenly Fate Key — there is something else... Be careful."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji nodded, but a thread of unease rose in his heart. What was this "other thing" Mister Mo mentioned? He looked down at Chen Nian in his arms, only to discover a诡异 purple light flickering faintly in the depths of her eyes... That was not the color of the Heavenly Fate Key. That was the color of the Heavenly Eye.
